coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (CHILD, ADULT) trial of LGG/HGG with BRAF aberration or NF1; glioblastoma never named, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified (excluded at S5). Coded fully. Hydroxychloroquine is the investigational add-on (outcome: 'adding HCQ to Dabrafenib + Trametinib'); dabrafenib and trametinib coded soc_backbone per manual C3 example, flagged uncertain. PK is plasma-only (Cmax, AUC) so tumour_pk_planned no; tumour/CSF sampling is for resistance biomarkers, not drug levels. Target engagement: LC3II and p62 autophagy markers in PBMCs for HCQ (blood PD; not listed as tumour biomarkers).
